title: Repository, Database, and Contract Preflight
mission: Inspect the real repository and database, verify the corrected official-forecast facts, identify existing conventions, and produce the immutable starting-state manifest.
inputs: Repository root and all AGENTS.md files
Audit bundle and existing experiment evidence
steps: Inspect repository structure, git status, branches, installed skills, migration stack, database libraries, environment-variable conventions, schedulers, object storage, tests and CI.
Enumerate database schemas, tables, views, functions, indexes, row counts, min/max timestamps, permissions and owners.
Run direct SQL against public.hko_historical_forecasts_2000_2026 to reproduce the 115,795-row clean subset, 9,667 distinct target dates, one missing date, product counts and numerical summaries.
Determine exact timezone semantics of issue columns; do not infer from names.
Locate all current dataset tables, loaders, acquisition scripts, model code and experiment registries.
Hash the repository inputs and record the starting git commit.
Create a discrepancy register; user-supplied facts are canonical only after verification.
acceptance: Official forecast counts exactly reproduced or discrepancy clearly proven
Every existing data/model table mapped to an owner and purpose
failure: Database unavailable: complete repository inspection and provide exact SQL command/blocker
Count mismatch: stop canonicalization and open blocker; do not silently continue
